missing: A direct pick: which specific power station (Wh capacity, inverter watts, measured noise in dB, current price) replaces a portable gas generator for a typical essentials load (fridge, sump pump, lights, phones), with runtime figures and realistic solar recharge time for a multi-day outage.
why: Consumer Reports holds three of the top slots with a lab-tested generator buying guide that explicitly covers portable power stations as the quiet, indoor-safe option, so a major reviewer answers the question in part, though with no direct battery-vs-gas pick. The rest is weak: four duplicate itechguides affiliate pages, a Harbor Freight retailer guide, a WVU safety page, an AP explainer, two unreadable Generac PDFs, and one niche site (Tested Watts) that compares with specs but admits it does not test. A focused page naming specific quiet power stations with capacity, noise, runtime, solar recharge and current prices could get in, but would sit beside CR rather than displace it.
